title: Introduce candidate-consistent EvaluationWorkspace
objective: Keep immutable base and candidate snapshots alive through build, extraction, every provider, packet assembly, and artifact persistence.
acceptance: Dirty operator checkout has no effect; head-only fixture is evaluated; cleanup occurs after packet persistence; snapshot hashes are stable.

title: Pass ProviderContext to all evidence providers
objective: Remove project_path-based provider execution and require workspace, executor, snapshot, extraction, deadline, and artifact store context.
acceptance: No provider reads the original checkout; every result records the candidate snapshot fingerprint; timeout/failure is explicit.

title: Eliminate direct host Lake execution in semantic providers
objective: Route examples, counterexamples, and downstream tests through the selected executor and sandbox policy.
acceptance: Static test forbids subprocess.run in providers; Docker-selected runs invoke no host Lake; network and env policies are preserved.

title: Harden Docker sandbox and pin image identity
objective: Use read-only root/source, non-root user, ephemeral writable mounts, CPU/storage limits, and image digest provenance.
acceptance: Sandbox tests assert every hardening flag; source checkout remains unchanged; unresolved image digest blocks automatic acceptance.

title: Remove duplicate sandbox isolation implementation
objective: Retain one isolation_status_for_executor implementation and prevent future duplicate definitions.
acceptance: One definition remains; lint/test detects duplicate top-level function names.

title: Implement generic injected Lean extractor
objective: Extract arbitrary supported Lake projects without target-defined lpe_extract targets or committed extraction JSON.
acceptance: Works on fixture, independent small project, medium project, Mathlib-backed downstream project, and bounded 10k-declaration module set.

title: Define Lean extraction protocol v2
objective: Record FQNs, kinds, modules, source positions, visibility, type/value hashes, axioms, edges, and dimension-specific completeness.
acceptance: Schema validates all compatibility fixtures; unsupported/missing dimensions are explicit; no global completeness ambiguity.

title: Extract paired base and candidate snapshots
objective: Produce independently fingerprinted base and head extraction artifacts in one run.
acceptance: Base/head artifacts are immutable; changed toolchain or tree invalidates reuse; stale artifacts are refused.

title: Implement elaborated declaration diff
objective: Classify added, removed, type-changed, body-only, visibility, attribute, axiom, dependency, and import changes.
acceptance: Multiline declarations, namespaces, FQNs, removals, and proof-only changes classify correctly; lexical fallback never auto-accepts.

title: Introduce evidence basis and coverage model
objective: Attach discrete basis, declared-scope coverage, subject references, and typed payloads to every finding.
acceptance: PASS cannot satisfy a stronger required basis; incomplete coverage cannot silently pass; historical packet migration is tested.

title: Make evidence packet identity fully reproducible
objective: Hash run manifest, provider versions, executor/image/toolchain, policy, canonical findings, and artifacts.
acceptance: Identical inputs yield identical fingerprint; provider/image/policy changes alter it; random IDs/timestamps do not affect it.

title: Move logs to content-addressed artifact store
objective: Keep packets bounded and preserve redacted, hash-addressed logs and extraction outputs.
acceptance: Packet stays below 1 MiB excluding refs; digest verification works; secrets are redacted before storage.

title: Replace semantic fixture heuristics with manifests
objective: Require obligation binding, expected exit/diagnostics, snapshot target, timeout, and semantic interpretation.
acceptance: README-only and arbitrary nonempty YAML cannot PASS; unrelated Lean failure is UNKNOWN; expected result is checked exactly.

title: Implement paired downstream successor tests
objective: Run declared successors on base and candidate and report enabled, regressed, and unchanged outcomes.
acceptance: Candidate-only success and regression are distinguished; all runs share candidate workspace/executor provenance.

title: Synthesize canonical API-fit and downstream findings
objective: Derive canonical checks from provider evidence and remove contradictory generic UNKNOWN findings.
acceptance: Synthesis policy is versioned; complete provider evidence deterministically changes canonical status; conflicts remain explicit.

title: Release schema 0.2.0 and migration
objective: Version candidate, packet, finding, provenance, and extraction schemas with read support for 0.1.0.
acceptance: Golden 0.1 records migrate; unknown data remains unresolved rather than inferred; schema drift CI passes.

title: Expand CI and release validation
objective: Add Python/OS matrix, Ruff, MyPy, coverage, package build/install, scheduled Lean/Docker/Mathlib, image scan, and live Check test.
acceptance: Required matrix passes; scheduled jobs publish artifacts; test counts and manifests are generated; release wheel and image are reproducible.

title: Define typed utility event union v2
objective: Replace dict payloads with discriminated event types for freezes, candidates, evidence, reviews, acceptance, persistence, time, corrections, and protocol.
acceptance: Every event validates against one payload type; anonymous/unknown fields fail; legacy unresolved records remain marked.

title: Implement artifact and obligation lifecycle reducers
objective: Enforce valid transitions, immutable obligation freezes, repair lineage, integration, downstream, and persistence ordering.
acceptance: Invalid transitions fail append; property tests cover arbitrary event sequences; corrections are deterministic.

title: Implement ledger 0.1 to 0.2 migration and resealing
objective: Preserve source history, migrate typed records, flag ambiguity, verify both chains, and issue linked seals.
acceptance: Migration is idempotent; no acceptance/persistence is invented; report accounts for every source event.

title: Implement dimension-specific review attestations
objective: Record semantic, repository, implementation, downstream, and adjudication decisions separately.
acceptance: One review cannot automatically attest multiple dimensions; fingerprint and conflict hash are mandatory.

title: Implement reviewer conflicts and eligibility
objective: Fail closed for authorship, historical review, direct collaboration, packet construction, prior outcome exposure, and declared conflicts.
acceptance: Ineligible reviewer cannot receive or submit primary attestation; signed conflict hash is immutable.

title: Implement R1–R4 quorum and acceptance aggregation
objective: Allow human-controlled R3/R4 acceptance with distinct reviewers while preserving no-auto-accept.
acceptance: R3 requires semantic+repository reviewers; R4 requires three roles; any reject blocks; aggregate event derives only from quorum.

title: Implement repair lineage and adjudication
objective: Create new candidate versions for repairs and independent provisional adjudication for disagreements.
acceptance: Prior attestations do not transfer; adjudicator conflict rules enforced; lineage is auditable.

title: Implement TPPR v2 reducer and audit report
objective: Compute unique sustained credit, typed time, corrections, condition cohorts, missing-data bounds, and full numerator/denominator audit.
acceptance: Property tests prevent duplicate/retroactive credit; persistence threshold enforced; report reconciles to ledger.

title: Implement machine-readable pilot protocol bundle
objective: Replace blank Markdown templates with required validated protocol, endpoint, roster, held-out, comprehension, analysis, and signature files.
acceptance: Freeze refuses any missing field; protocol hashes all components; changes after freeze create a new version.

title: Implement deterministic blocked condition assignment
objective: Use 2:2:1 balanced blocks, HMAC seed, risk/type strata, workload balance, and conflict exclusion.
acceptance: Same frozen seed reproduces assignment; quotas hold; no ineligible reviewer is assigned; seed disclosure verifies assignments.

title: Implement reviewer calibration and comprehension
objective: Administer five external cases, score evidence-basis and root-cause comprehension, and enforce eligibility.
acceptance: Pass/fail rules are deterministic; second failure excludes reviewer from primary analysis; results are sealed.

title: Implement pilot data lock
objective: Verify completeness, assignments, chain, off-host seal, hashes, exclusions, analysis image, and held-out set before lock.
acceptance: Any mismatch blocks lock; locked bundle is content-addressed; post-lock corrections create a new analysis version.

title: Implement pilot analysis and §21 gate evaluator
objective: Compute descriptive metrics, agreement, bootstrap intervals, advancement thresholds, and machine-readable authorization.
acceptance: Frozen synthetic/golden datasets produce expected gates; incomplete data blocks authorization; report preserves non-claims.

title: Productize live GitHub Check integration
objective: Run a required-check E2E against a dedicated repository, including fail-closed ESCALATE behavior.
acceptance: Live check creates, updates, and concludes correctly; missing auth fails clearly; no token reaches candidate execution.

title: Synchronize versions, docs, audit, tree, and manifest
objective: Use one generated source of truth for release status, tests, compatibility, non-claims, tree, and checksums.
acceptance: CI fails on drift; README no longer describes M3/M4 as deferred; package version matches release.

title: Select and freeze first partner repository
objective: Choose an active repository, domain lead, frozen obligations, held-out set, reviewer roster, dates, and signatures.
acceptance: Protocol bundle validates and freezes; all human roles and conflicts are resolved; no blank required field exists.

title: Execute 30–50 prospective pilot episodes
objective: Complete control, instrumented, and shadow review episodes with expert time, evidence, repairs, and assignments.
acceptance: Minimum quotas and risk coverage met; no protocol deviations unresolved; ledger and seals verify.

title: Complete integration and 30-day persistence follow-up
objective: Record integration, downstream enablement, regressions, and persistence under the frozen rules.
acceptance: Every accepted obligation has completed or explicitly censored persistence outcome; TPPR audit is complete.

title: Lock, analyze, and publish pilot report
objective: Run sealed analysis, §21 gates, methodological limitations, and engineering findings.
acceptance: Analysis reproduces from locked bundle; claims match gates; software and causal conclusions are separated.

title: Implement learned review routing
objective: Train a question-ranking policy against deterministic_baseline.v1 with project/time/lineage held-out splits.
acceptance: At least 15% held-out review-minute improvement, no safety degradation, calibrated abstention, model card and reproducibility.

title: Evaluate project-targeted synthesis
objective: Compare equal-budget data selection arms and measure held-out TPPR improvement.
acceptance: Equal budgets verified; fresh-project TPPR improves; all secondary metrics and limitations reported.
